engine: studio-video-engine seedvr2 plan CLI tests (engine/seedvr2/plan.py refuse_output_inside, tests/test_seedvr2_adopt.py)
environment: Windows 11, pytest run with --basetemp inside production-local (protected tree)
symptom: Three seedvr2 CLI tests failed when pytest --basetemp pointed inside production-local, because the protected-tree guard refused the scratch output.
root_cause: Measured by the failing run: refuse_output_inside treats any folder under the repo root or production-local as a protected episode tree. A pytest basetemp placed there is refused by design, so the failure is in the test invocation, not in the seedvr2 code. Current guard: engine/seedvr2/plan.py:268-279 (container_roots; a folder inside the containers is judged by the precise trees, not by location alone) and tests/test_seedvr2_adopt.py:26-40 (scratch under the episodes-root engine/staging is accepted).
root_cause_status: measured (3 CLI tests failed with --basetemp inside production-local; passed after the basetemp was moved). Current sha256 engine/seedvr2/plan.py 780f54cdffd8d429692c7ab14dce780f5b917e836a2045ec5b2c75ef89ac430c
fix_or_workaround: Run pytest with --basetemp in a scratch folder OUTSIDE production-local (the skill's own test command uses <scratch>/pytest-e15 for this reason, SKILL.md:330). Engine/staging under the episodes root is accepted by the precise check. Accepted: CLI-PATCH-adopt plan 2 and hardening 1 (engine/seedvr2/CLI-PATCH-adopt.md:39-41).
verification: tests/test_seedvr2_adopt.py::test_scratch_under_the_episodes_root_engine_staging_is_accepted (:40) plus the refusal cases in the same file. The three CLI tests pass with a basetemp outside production-local. The 'outside production-local' rule itself is enforced only by the command in SKILL.md:330, not by a test.
prevention: Rule to keep: never point --basetemp or any scratch folder inside production-local or the repo root. Use <scratch> outside the protected trees, and run the full suite from the engine root with -p no:cacheprovider.
status: workaround in the documented test command; the protected-tree guard itself is correct
